**Download `PartyLine.exe` below** (under *Assets*) and double-click it. No install needed.

- Your browser may warn that the file isn't commonly downloaded: choose **Keep**.
- Windows may say "Windows protected your PC": click **More info → Run anyway**. (The app isn't code-signed.)
- The first time you press START it downloads the speech model (Small ≈ 480 MB).
